answer: Private canary leakage gives each identity secret marker facts planted only in its own tasks, such as a fable about a sparrow with a teal plume that exists nowhere else. If that sparrow, or any of the 20 canaries an identity gets per epoch, shows up in another identity's output, both are flagged as sharing one memory or session and their unvested rewards freeze. One leak is enough, and rewording can't hide it because canaries are rare facts, not phrasing. So a farm must run every fake as a fully isolated context with its own storage and compute, paying full cost per persona.
